generator: Existing frozen SDXL Turbo images only; no generator/SAE inference
selection: Exploratory Indian-man and Middle-Eastern-man subset selected after inspecting seed30 pilot; all five seeds retained
inference_rule: SAM model-quality argmax per prompt, preserve all3 candidates and logits
presence_gate: None: nonempty masks are proposals, not evidence of beard presence
definitions: Candidate chin/jaw region excludes lips/moustache by negative prompting intent; semantic membership unverified
metrics: Raw proposal area, overlap with fixed lower-face ROI and lips, prompt sensitivity, paired proposal-area changes; NOT validated beard coverage
